description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier class, which is responsible for filtering and sanitizing HTML content to ensure it is safe and standards-compliant. It includes methods for purifying individual HTML snippets or arrays of snippets, manages configuration, filters, and the purification process, and implements a singleton pattern.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier
classes.description: Main class responsible for HTML sanitization, configuration management, and singleton pattern implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purifier with optional configuration.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom filter to the purifier (deprecated method).

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Filters an HTML snippet to be XSS-free and standards-compliant.

methods.name: purifyArray
methods.description: Filters an array of HTML snippets.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HTMLPurifier, optionally setting it.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Backwards compatibility method for singleton access.
